Title: Sushi Making Experience Namba
Description:
• The most popular sushi making experience in Osaka,dotonbori! 
  • Make 12 pieces of sushi, including 2 types (Nigiri,Gunkan-sushi) from ingredients
  • Vegetarian, Vegan, Halal menu available 
  • Sushi-chef costume 
  • Japanese sake and beer 
  • All guidance are in English

Title: Osaka walking tour: Namba local tour by local guide
Description:
• Guided walking tour led by young, friendly locals
  • Enjoy the atmosphere of Osaka’s most vibrant areas
  • Learn about daily life and Japanese culture in a casual way
  • Ideal for travelers seeking an authentic local experience

Title: Sushi Making Class for Vegan or Vegetarian
Description:
The most popular sushi making class in Osaka, doutonbori!
You can learn how to make sushi from ingredients.
We will teach you the details so that you become able to make sushi at home.
・12 pieces of sushi(nigiri style, gunkan style)
・You can enjoy Japanese sake and beer

Title: Osaka Halal Sushi Making Experience
Description:
Don't just eat sushi, learn how to make it at home in this centrally-located cooking class in Osaka. Practice the techniques to make perfect sushi and learn about the many different styles, from nigiri to gunkan. Get personalized tips from your guides so you can sharpen your Japanese cooking skills.

・The class is conveniently located in Dōtonbori, Osaka
・Learn the ingredients required to make 12 pieces of sushi at home
・Eat when you're hungriest with afternoon and evening class options
・Vegetarian, vegan, and halal sushi is available upon request
